svg.aria-label: Two shaders assembled, checker-branch.asm and escape.asm (the loop shader lesson 6 runs on a warp), one row per instruction with its number in code and its source line, the match fields assemble stored on each if, else, break and endloop, and an arrow for each jump runLane makes from them: checker-branch.asm: if 7 to 12, else 11 to 15; escape.asm: break 12 to 19, endloop 18 to 6.
svg.desc: Two shaders assembled, checker-branch.asm and escape.asm (the loop shader lesson 6 runs on a warp), one row per instruction with its number in code and its source line, the match fields assemble stored on each if, else, break and endloop, and an arrow for each jump runLane makes from them: checker-branch.asm: if 7 to 12, else 11 to 15; escape.asm: break 12 to 19, endloop 18 to 6.
svg.text: Jump targets, filled in by assemble
Left: instruction number in code, then source line.
Middle: the match fields assemble stored. Arrows:

svg.text: A false if goes to its else + 1, or to its endif when it
has no else. An else goes to its endif. A taken break goes
past its endloop; an endloop goes back to just after its loop.
